queries.query: "large language model" "network configuration" generation failure modes misconfiguration
queries.rationale: Locate studies reporting or analyzing failures when LLMs generate network configurations or operational artifacts; core to the phenomenon of incorrect NetOps outputs.
Target literature on hallucination-style errors applied to operational actions or configurations in networking contexts.
Search for architectures that combine generation with verification and repair specifically for network configurations (generate→validate→repair patterns).

queries.query: network configuration verification Batfish NetPlumber header space analysis formal verification "network verification"
queries.rationale: Survey established deterministic/network-verification tools and methods (Batfish, NetPlumber, HSA, header space analysis) to assess compatibility with LLM-generated artifacts and potential validators.
Identify agentic or tool-augmented LLM frameworks and patterns (tool use, planning+tool invocation) applicable to NetOps orchestration and safe execution.

queries.query: agentic AI autonomous operators safety "autonomous agent" "operations" "safety"
queries.rationale: Find literature on safety, reliability, and governance of agentic/autonomous AI systems performing operational tasks, to inform threat models and mitigations.
Collect existing benchmark suites and evaluation frameworks for AIOps/NetOps to assess benchmark validity and gaps for LLM-driven NetOps.

queries.query: evaluation methodology LLMs safety critical systems "robustness" "external validity" benchmark limitations
queries.rationale: Survey methodological literature on evaluating LLMs in safety-critical or mission-critical settings, focusing on validity threats and best practices for experiments and benchmarks.

queries.query: formal methods SMT SAT model checking network configurations "formal verification" "network config"
queries.rationale: Locate formal verification approaches (SMT, model checking, theorem proving) used for verifying network invariants and how they might serve as validators or oracles for LLM outputs.

queries.query: network simulation and emulation testbeds Mininet ns-3 GNS3 "evaluation" NetOps
queries.rationale: Identify simulators/emulators and testbeds used to execute or validate network configurations and workflows for controlled evaluation of LLM-generated changes.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop oversight automated NetOps "human-in-the-loop" operator review automation safety
queries.rationale: Search for studies on human oversight, verification workflows, and operator interfaces when automation suggests configuration or operational changes.

queries.query: adversarial attacks on LLMs "prompt injection" "data poisoning" "safety" networked systems
queries.rationale: Gather work on adversarial and prompt-injection attacks against LLM-driven workflows and their implications for NetOps security and robustness.

queries.query: network configuration datasets RANCID router configs public dataset "network configuration dataset"
queries.rationale: Find publicly available datasets of real or realistic network configurations and change histories to enable empirical evaluation and reproducibility.

queries.query: case study "LLM" outage automation failure "real-world" incident report "production"
queries.rationale: Seek documented real-world incidents or case studies where automated or model-driven decisions caused measurable operational failures, for failure-mode evidence and grounding.

queries.query: benchmark validity reproducibility ML for systems "dataset shift" "representativeness" "evaluation pitfalls"
queries.rationale: Collect meta-analyses on benchmark design, representativeness, and reproducibility in ML-for-systems to critique and design valid NetOps evaluations for LLMs.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, preprints on arXiv, official project repositories, conference proceedings)
Works addressing LLMs or generative models applied to operational tasks or networking, or general LLM safety/robustness research transferable to NetOps
Public datasets, tool repos, and benchmarks with accessible artifacts or reproducibility notes
Methodological papers on evaluation validity, formal verification, simulation/emulation, or human-in-loop oversight
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical marketing materials, vendor whitepapers without reproducible methods or artifacts
Opinion pieces or blog posts that do not cite primary evidence (can be used only for leads)
Pre-lock private/development artifacts or unpublished internal reports not publicly available
date_rationale: Cover foundational work from ~2016 onward (network verification and formal methods), with prioritized coverage of 2020–2026 literature because of the rapid emergence of large generative models and agentic frameworks; include earlier seminal verification/formal-methods work as necessary for mechanisms and validators.
